caption: The drawing depicts an oval, cream-colored ceramic plate with a scalloped edge. The rim of the plate is decorated with clusters of small pink roses and green foliage, distributed evenly around the edge. The plate sits centered within a large, lightly outlined rectangle. Below the plate, three smaller elements are present: on the left, a black and white illustrated maker's mark labeled "MELODA & CO"; in the center, a technical outline drawing of the plate showing its shape from above and the side; and to the right, a handwritten signature with the name "Sudek." The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Dinner Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
